reply.text:
Depends on what you're chasing. If the goal is size or strength, I'd lean nay right after lifting. Research suggests regular cold water immersion straight after resistance training can blunt some of the muscle-building signal, so it works against the very adaptation you trained for.

It's not a villain, though. Cold can make you feel fresher between hard sessions, and it's fine on a day when recovery matters more than gains, like during a tournament or a stacked week. If you love it, push it to a few hours after training or put it on a non-lifting day.

If you're in a hypertrophy block, I'd skip it post-lift. If you want, tell me what you're training for right now and I'll give you a more specific take.
